A 2x2 character design sheet of a young East Asian woman standing on the wooden deck of a sailing ship at sea during golden hour. The sheet includes four panels: a front close-up portrait, a side close-up portrait, a back full-body view, and a front full-body view. She has a short black bob haircut with soft bangs, delicate facial features, pale skin, amber-brown eyes, and a calm, slightly distant expression. A thin red braided tassel hair ornament hangs beside her face, with a wooden hairpin tucked into her hair.
She wears a semi-sheer white traditional-inspired blouse with a high mandarin collar, frog button closures, and translucent long puff sleeves. Her lower outfit is a long black high-waisted skirt with a deep side slit, revealing one pale thigh and a white thigh-high stocking. A dark red sash is tied around her waist with long ribbon ends hanging down. A small brown waist pouch with paper talismans is attached at the front side of her belt. She wears simple black low heels.
The environment is the deck of an old sailing ship, with wooden planks, ropes, masts, and sails visible in the background, with the ocean and horizon behind her. Warm sunlight from the side and behind creates soft highlights on her hair and clothing. The composition is clean and elegant, with each panel clearly separated, emphasizing costume details, hairstyle, and full-body outfit design.
